findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (passed 66 to 47)
findings.note: Voted Aye on second reading of HB 958, a broad election law bill. The bill's official digest says it extends the deadline for a voter to show photo ID after voting a provisional ballot without ID, changes how citizenship is checked on voter registration forms, and sets steps for removing non-citizens and deceased people from voter rolls. On the same day he voted Aye on amendment A1 (112 to 0) and amendment A2 (69 to 44), and No on amendment A3 (failed 47 to 66).

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, M11 Concur with Senate changes (passed 62 to 47)
findings.note: Voted Aye to concur with the Senate version of HB 958, the final passage vote. The bill page shows the governor vetoed it on 08/17/2026. The listed votes through the end of the August 2026 session show no override vote for HB 958 on his record.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes: governor's veto (context for the votes above)
findings.note: Official bill page for HB 958 lists the action 'Vetoed 08/17/2026'. Context only. The digest at https://webservices.ncleg.gov/BillDigests/2025/H958 says the act requires military and overseas voters to send the photo ID described in GS 163-166.16(a) with the ballot, and extends the time to bring ID after a provisional ballot from the third to the fifth business day after the election.
